en_title: Jason Showers in His Underwear in the Japanese Version of GTA 6, but Censorship Is Nothing New for Rockstar Games
cn_title: 《GTA6》日版中Jason穿着内裤洗澡，但内容审查对Rockstar来说并不新鲜
opus_summary: 《GTA6》日版削减了血腥和裸露内容，Jason洗澡时穿着内裤，裸体海滩游客也被加上内裤。日版移除了血腥程度调节选项，但保留了肢解开关。Rockstar此前的多款游戏也曾在日本遭遇类似审查。

paragraphs.en: GTA 6 is finally here, but for players in Japan the experience is looking a bit different. Pre-release concerns about censorship have proven to be founded, with blood, gore, and nudity getting dialed down, but also some more surprising changes.
paragraphs.cn: 《GTA6》终于推出了，但日本玩家的体验看起来有些不同。发行前对内容审查的担忧已被证明并非空穴来风：血液、血腥和裸露内容有所减少，同时还有一些更令人意外的改动。

paragraphs.en: One difference in the Japanese version that’s quickly attracted attention is nudity censorship. But one change in particular is drawing puzzled and disappointed reactions. In most versions of the game, you can see Jason’s naked back and bottom when he takes a shower. However, in the Japanese version, black underwear now mostly covers his butt. Nude beachgoers have also been given underwear.
paragraphs.cn: 日版中一处迅速引起关注的差异是对裸露内容的审查。但其中一项改动尤其让人感到困惑和失望。在游戏的大多数版本中，Jason洗澡时可以看到他裸露的背部和臀部。然而在日版中，黑色内裤现在遮住了他的大部分臀部。裸体海滩游客也被加上了内裤。

paragraphs.en: “GTA 6 takes place in such a realistic world, but I hate how this sloppy, out-of-place censorship breaks my immersion.” commented one X user in Japanese. Although Japan has censored full-frontal nudity in games before (such as by adding strategically placed figleaves in Baldur’s Gate 3), a brief glimpse of someone’s bottom has previously been allowed. In Death Stranding, for example, you can see Sam’s bare bottom in the shower, even in the Japanese version.
paragraphs.cn: 一名X用户用日语评论道：「《GTA6》的世界如此真实，但我讨厌这种粗糙、不合时宜的审查破坏我的沉浸感。」虽然日本此前曾审查游戏中的正面全裸画面（例如在《Baldur’s Gate 3》中于关键部位加上无花果叶），但此前短暂露出人物臀部是被允许的。例如在《死亡搁浅》中，即使是日版，也能看到Sam洗澡时裸露的臀部。

paragraphs.en: Japanese news site Game*Spark also spotted some noticeable differences in gore between GTA6’s Japanese and Western releases. In the display settings menu, you can toggle Blood & Gore Intensity on a scale of low to high. The Japanese release completely removes this option. Although bloodstains remain on the ground and on people’s clothing in the Japanese version, there is far less blood compared to Western versions, suggesting that the Japanese version is locked at a lower gore intensity.
paragraphs.cn: 日本新闻网站Game*Spark还发现，《GTA6》日版与西方发行版本在血腥内容上存在一些明显差异。在显示设置菜单中，玩家可以将血液与血腥程度从低到高进行调整。日版完全移除了这一选项。虽然日版中地面和人物衣服上仍有血迹，但血液量比西方版本少得多，这表明日版的血腥程度被锁定在较低水平。

paragraphs.en: However, the Japanese version does still have the option to toggle dismemberment on or off, although it’s toned down compared to GTA 6 in other regions. Japan’s CERO ratings board has previously called on game developers to censor or even remove dismemberment and decapitation in the past. As Game*Spark noted, “Jason wears underwear in the shower but can still blow people’s heads off.”
paragraphs.cn: 不过，日版仍然提供开启或关闭断肢效果的选项，只是与其他地区的《GTA6》相比有所削弱。日本CERO评级机构过去曾要求游戏开发者审查甚至移除断肢和斩首内容。正如Game*Spark所指出的：「Jason洗澡时穿着内裤，但仍然可以把别人的头轰掉。」

paragraphs.en: CERO (Computer Entertainment Rating Organization) is Japan’s age rating board for video games. Although games can be released on digital storefronts with a rating from the IARC instead, a CERO rating is required for 18+ games and physical releases. GTA 6 received a Z (18+) certificate, CERO’s highest rating. To get a CERO rating, a game has to be submitted for review on each of the platforms it will be released on, making the rating process for multiplatform games potentially time consuming and costly (source: Automaton ). If the game fails to pass the first review, the developer must make changes based on CERO’s comments and resubmit. In this case, Jason’s shower underwear might be a result of Rockstar being extra cautious in making sure GTA 6 could get a CERO certification in time for a smooth, worldwide release.
paragraphs.cn: CERO（Computer Entertainment Rating Organization）是日本的电子游戏年龄评级机构。虽然游戏也可以凭借IARC评级在数字商店发行，但18岁以上游戏和实体版发行需要获得CERO评级。《GTA6》获得了Z（18岁以上）认证，即CERO的最高评级。要获得CERO评级，游戏必须针对每个发行平台分别提交审核，这可能使多平台游戏的评级流程既耗时又昂贵（来源：Automaton）。如果游戏未能通过首次审核，开发者必须根据CERO的意见进行修改并重新提交。在本例中，Jason洗澡时穿的内裤可能是Rockstar为了确保《GTA6》能够及时获得CERO认证、顺利在全球发行而采取额外谨慎措施的结果。

paragraphs.en: Prior to GTA 6’s launch, fans were already concerned that the Japanese version would be heavily censored. Japan’s PS5 and Xbox store pages only show CERO content warning icons for violence and crime, in contrast to overseas release ratings. Conversely, North America’s ESRB mentions strong sexual content and nudity, among other content warnings.
paragraphs.cn: 在《GTA6》发售之前，粉丝们就已担心日版会受到严格审查。与海外发行版本的评级不同，日本的PS5和XBOX商店页面只显示了暴力和犯罪的CERO内容警告图标。相比之下，北美ESRB的内容警告中则提到了强烈性内容和裸露等内容。

paragraphs.en: Other Rockstar games have received similar censorship in Japan. In GTA 5, for example, sex scenes were cut and most of the torture section got axed. Red Dead Redemption 1 and 2 had nudity and sex scenes removed and reduced gory details (especially in RDR2’s American Dreams mission). LA Noire also had nudity censored, with the naked bodies in the homicide cases partially covered by blankets.
paragraphs.cn: Rockstar的其他游戏在日本也受到过类似审查。例如，《GTA5》删去了性爱场景，酷刑环节的大部分内容也被砍掉。《荒野大镖客：救赎》和《荒野大镖客：救赎2》移除了裸露和性爱场景，并减少了血腥细节（尤其是《荒野大镖客：救赎2》的American梦想大创造任务）。《LA Noire》的裸露内容也受到审查，凶杀案件中的裸体尸体被毯子部分遮盖。

paragraphs.en: Some Japanese users who are unhappy with the censorship have tried downloading overseas versions. However, one big issue is that only the Japanese release offers Japanese language support. “Ugh, forget it… I’ll study English and buy the North American version,” one Japanese user reacted . However, if GTA 6 ever comes to PC, Japanese gamers may get a version that is closer to Western releases, as CERO ratings are not required for PC games.
paragraphs.cn: 一些对审查不满的日本用户尝试下载海外版本。然而，一个大问题是只有日版提供日语支持。一名日本用户回应道：「唉，算了……我要学英语，买北美版。」不过，如果《GTA6》将来登陆PC，日本玩家或许能玩到更接近西方发行版本的版本，因为PC游戏不需要CERO评级。

paragraphs.en: Just getting started in GTA 6 or wondering what to do next? Check out the Official Grand Theft Auto 6 guide right here on IGN. If you're still getting your bearings, discover GTA's new systems with the Beginner's Guide - 67 Tips and Tricks , or get all the details on the first chapters with the Chapter 1 Guide and Tips and Chapter 2 Guide and Tips . If you're already driving all around Leonida and want to know everything there is to find and do, see the Leonida interactive map .
paragraphs.cn: 刚开始玩《GTA6》，或是不知道接下来该做什么？不妨在IGN查看《GTA6》官方指南。如果你还在熟悉游戏，可以通过新手指南中的67条提示与技巧了解《侠盗猎车手》的新系统，或者通过第一章指南与提示以及第二章指南与提示，了解开头几个章节的全部细节。如果你已经开车游遍Leonida，并想知道所有可以发现和完成的内容，可以查看Leonida互动地图。

paragraphs.en: Verity Townsend is a Japan-based freelance writer who previously served as editor, contributor and translator for the game news site Automaton West. She has also written about Japanese culture and movies for various publications.
paragraphs.cn: Verity Townsend是一名常驻日本的自由撰稿人，曾担任游戏新闻网站Automaton West的编辑、撰稿人和翻译。她还曾为多家出版物撰写有关日本文化和电影的文章。
